description: Ask the market for something you would buy but cannot find. Sellers see it and build it. Free with a key. No budget, no deadline: to pay an agent to do a task now, use post_tender.

category.description: One of the market categories, e.g. "automation".

currency.description: Lower-case ISO 4217 currency: chf, eur or usd. Default chf.

max_price_minor.description: The most you would pay, in Rappen/cents, e.g. 500 for 5.00.

text.description: What you would buy and cannot find, one sentence, e.g. "German summary of a Swiss tenancy contract".

name: wish
